extracted.intended_audience: readers, editors, and writers of American short fiction (anthology readers / short-story community)
extracted.subtask_description: Criteria and editorial signals for choosing and presenting short stories in an annual American anthology; focuses on qualities that make stories 'worthy' of inclusion and editorial balance among publication sources. Useful for anthology editors, selectors, and writers aiming for anthology publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consistency of excellence across varied stories
rubrics_metrics.description: “Its stories, differing widely in subject matter, technique, tone and effect, maintain a remarkable consistency of excellence.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Despite diversity in subject, technique, tone and effect, the anthology should present a collection in which no piece is second-rate; strive for uniformly high quality across selections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrity of each piece
rubrics_metrics.description: “Every piece shows its own fine integrity.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each selected story should stand on its own merits — be internally coherent, fully realized, and demonstrate craft and moral/structural integrity; avoid including work that feels incomplete or compromised.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stories must convey human experience vicariously
rubrics_metrics.description: “And all of them do what good stories must do: they share thru words some stretch of human experience, so that it becomes, vicariously, the reader’s own.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selections should make readers feel and inhabit experiences through language; prioritize stories that translate human experience into a convincing, empathetic reader experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diversity of subject matter, technique, tone, and effect
rubrics_metrics.description: “Stories, differing widely in subject matter, technique, tone and effect...”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aim for a varied program of pieces (different themes, narrative methods, voices and emotional registers) so the anthology showcases the range of contemporary short fiction while still maintaining overall quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Balance of sources from major and smaller magazines
rubrics_metrics.description: “The usual proportion of stories from big and little magazines has been pretty well maintained. Ten of the choices are from well-known magazines of national circulation... Twelve of the stories were first published in admirable magazines which unfortunately do not have large circulations...”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Curators should balance selections between widely circulated national magazines and smaller, reputable literary journals — recognizing both visibility and literary merit when compiling the year’s best.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognition of work first published in 'admirable' smaller venues
rubrics_metrics.description: “Twelve of the stories were first published in admirable magazines which unfortunately do not have large circulations or widely known reputations among the general reading public.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give attention to standout stories appearing in lesser-known but respected journals; inclusion can surface quality writing that lacks broad exposure.
